families.name: tabular-data
families.guidance: Use DataTable for sortable/filterable records; use Table only for a deliberately static, small table. Migrate EnhancedDataTable by moving its data/query behavior into the DataTable data contract.

families.name: list-data
families.guidance: Use List for read-only collections, ListBox for selectable options, and DataList for label/value metadata. Do not introduce a new list variant.

families.name: navigation-links
families.guidance: Use Link for application navigation and A for a raw semantic anchor. Use NavLink only inside navigation composition; migrate ad-hoc link wrappers to Link.

families.name: dialog-overlays
families.guidance: Use Dialog for general interactive overlays and AlertDialog for destructive confirmation. Modal remains a compatibility spelling and should not receive new surface area.
